description: This file contains a utility function 'maskApiKey' designed to obfuscate API keys or sensitive strings by masking parts of the string based on its length.

methods.name: maskApiKey
methods.description: Obfuscates a given string by masking its middle portion, depending on its length. If the string is empty or only whitespace, returns 'missing'. For short strings, it partially masks them; for longer strings, it masks the middle eight characters.
